title: Turborepo + pnpm Workspaces
summary: Turborepo, pnpm workspaces, shared UI and contract packages
rules: Strict package boundaries: apps never import directly from sibling app directories.
Shared types and contracts live in packages/shared-types and must be imported via package exports.
Ensure all turbo.json pipeline tasks declare inputs and outputs for cache integrity.
Root AGENTS.md controls global workspace rules; app-level rules overlay local concerns.
